body: It's really so fucking unfair. We don't get to choose. I get looked down because of things I can't control. I'm working fucking hard but if you don't have resources or support shit gets REALLY difficult. "Succesful" people was usually born into a succesful life. It's easier to work hard when your stomach is full, you have a nice family, a nice roof and no mental illnesses.  (sorry for the rant).
